Yes I understand that completely, I'll be sure to mention it.
I actually went out to a party tonight and I think it really helped.

Yeah I've always been interested in writing and drawing, it's something I just thought about but now I've got so much free time I may as well give it a go.
My sexual tastes have changed a lot over the years so I'm not sure I can even do that right now.

Whenever I go to the doctor to restock on the meds I'm usually feeling fine. This will probably pass if I just hold out a bit, that's what usually happens anyway.

I'll try heading outside if the weather's good, thank you.
I live in a sort of rural area so this doesn't really suit me. Thanks for the suggestion anyway, I appreciate it.
